facts.text: After the evaluation, results are forwarded to a proprietary trading partner (such as Helios Trading Partners or Appius Trading Limited) which offers the LiveSim or Live account; that partner contract is not published on the Earn2Trade site.
30% consistency rule during the evaluation phase only.
'Earn2Trade never changes the rules retroactively': updated rules apply only to evaluations purchased on or after the change date.
